history.summary: Freehold D15 1BR at $1,090,000 ($1,985 psf), a touch above the $1,940 median, in the East Coast lifestyle belt. 4.9%/yr URA rate on a healthy 35-txn sample is credible, but a 549 sqft 1BR is the narrowest tenant/buyer pool and over $1M quantum for a shoebox is rich.
history.rating_rationale: Solid freehold East Coast location with a reliable ~4.9% appreciation rate (35 txns) supports the case, and 1BR rental demand in Katong/Tanjong Katong is real. But $1,985 psf is above median, the 1BR is niche on exit, and at 1.06 km the TEL station is a long walk. Strengths and concerns balance.
red_flags: 1BR at $1.09M — premium PSF for a shoebox, narrow resale pool
catalysts: Freehold D15 East Coast with deep lifestyle/rental demand
TEL fully operational improves area connectivity
